assumptions.vent_gas: Nitrogen; the FullFlow config identifies nitrogen as the pressurant.
assumptions.vent_process: Adiabatic ideal-gas blowdown to ambient through the valve CdA; no piping restriction, heat transfer, or two-phase flow.
assumptions.drain_process: Incompressible LOX discharge to ambient at the listed fixed ullage gauge pressures; no flashing, piping restriction, or outlet back-pressure.
assumptions.fill_process: Incompressible LOX fill through a fixed ground-fill path and OFD in series, to a tank held at the listed fixed ullage gauge pressure. The script solves the supply pressure needed for fill_reference_ofd_cda_mm2 to reach the liquid-transfer portion of fill_target_time_s after subtracting chilldown_and_boiloff_delay_s, then holds that calculated supply pressure fixed while sweeping OFD CdA. The delay is a first-pass lumped representation of chilldown, boiloff, and conditioning; it is calibrated so the reference case reaches the documented 48 min total 90% fill time. The 50 mm2 ground-path CdA is a provisional 3/8 in valve estimate (0.375 in bore, Cd about 0.70), not a tested ground-system flow coefficient. Hydrostatic pressure of the rising liquid column is included. No hose, QD, line, vent, heat-leak, flashing, or back-pressure restrictions are otherwise included.
assumptions.fill_delay_calibration: The 48 min Elytra reference corresponds to about 0.0658 kg/s for its 418 lbm 90% fill. Applying that average liquid-transfer rate to the 14.398 kg Hopper 90% fill gives 218.7 s of liquid transfer; the remaining 2661.3 s is modeled as the configurable conditioning delay.
assumptions.tank_inside_diameter_in: FullFlow notes 8.5 in OD. This isolated drain model uses 8.5 in as an unverified effective ID.
